literal: Even in the least, approaching avoid, of those who are intimate at home but in public slander, the friendship.
translation: Avoid even the slightest closeness with the friendship of those who act intimately in private but slander you in public.
modern: வீட்டில் நெருக்கமாகப் பழகிவிட்டு, பொது அவையில் நம்மைப் பழித்துப் பேசுபவர்களின் நட்பை எவ்வளவும் நெருங்காமல் தவிர்த்தல் வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet warns us against hypocritical friends. The poet advises us to completely avoid (ஓம்பல்) even the slightest closeness (எனைத்தும் குறுகுதல்) with people who behave with great intimacy inside our homes (மனைக்கு எழீஇ) but speak ill of us or slander us in public assemblies (மன்றில் பழிப்பார்). The contrast between the private space of the home and the public space of the assembly highlights their deceitful nature. True friendship cannot coexist with such double standards, and keeping any connection with them is dangerous.
